Reference

CLI reference

Canonical subcommands are best for scripts and team documentation. Shorthand aliases remain available for fast interactive use.

Core commands

kite init

Initialize a Flutter project foundation.

kite feature <name>

Generate a feature using a supported architecture.

kite component <names...>

Generate one or more reusable shared components.

kite state riverpod

Generate the Riverpod production foundation.

kite api dio

Generate the Dio API foundation and requirements.

kite doctor

Validate the local Dart, Flutter, project, and template environment.

kite templates

List public templates. Add --all for internal requirements.

kite upgrade

Upgrade Kite-managed generations with conflict protection.

Shorthand forms

ShorthandCanonical form
kite --feat:clean dashboardkite feature dashboard --architecture clean
kite --feat:mvc profilekite feature profile --architecture mvc
kite --widget buttonkite component button
kite --widget "[button,card,avatar]"kite component button card avatar
kite --state riverpodkite state riverpod
kite --api:diokite api dio

Shared generation flags

FlagMeaning
--path <directory>Target another Flutter project.
--dry-runPreview planned files and dependencies.
--forceOverwrite conflicts.
--skip-existingPreserve existing target files.
--no-dependenciesDo not install package requirements.
--no-formatDo not run Dart formatting.

Feature-only flags

FlagMeaning
--architecture clean|mvcSelect the feature template.
--cleanAlias for clean architecture.
--mvcAlias for MVC architecture.
--routeGenerate and register a feature route.
--jsonUse JSON serialization templates and add build dependencies.

Examples

kite init --dry-run
kite feature attendance --clean --route --json
kite feature settings --mvc --route
kite component button card avatar --skip-existing
kite state riverpod --path ./apps/admin
kite api dio --no-format
kite upgrade --dry-run
